name: Relapsing Polychondritis
definition: Rare immune-mediated disease causing recurrent inflammation of cartilage, especially ears, nose, respiratory tract and sometimes joints.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical with organ-directed imaging/labs and exclusion of mimics.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Airway disease can be life-threatening and requires specialist immunosuppression/intervention.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-upadhatu/cartilage inflammatory phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Rare immune-mediated disease causing recurrent inflammation of cartilage, especially ears, nose, respiratory tract and sometimes joints.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
